text:
Within the Washington Operations Center (WOC) there  is a conference bridge
 with approximately 3 80 telephone lines.  There are ten tape-recorders capable of
 recording conversations that occur on the conference bridge. The default setting is
  to not automatically record calls raking place on the bridge. They can activate a
 tape-recorder on any conference call taking place on the conference bridge.

 The Domestic Events Network (DEN), which is run over the conference bridge,
  uses approximately, on average, 100 lines. The DEN is always tape-recorded.
label: Conference bridge and DEN recording/capacity

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text:
There are four CCP (not further identified) telephone lines, which are used for the
 Administrator and her Deputies to call into the WOC on a priority basis. The CCP
  lines are intentionally not recorded. The only way a call that comes in on the CCP
 can be recorded is if the call is transferred to the conference bridge.
label: Priority CCP line exception

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text: The WOC has approximately eight secure telephone equipment (STE) phones.
label: STE count

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text:
The secure video system (SVS) in the WOC is not recorded on the FAA side. The
FAA is not the owner of the system; they are merely users of the system. The SVS
is managed by the Whitehouse Communications Agency.
label: Secure video ownership and recording scope

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text:
The FAA WOC also has one fixed and one portable satellite telephone. The FAA
owns the equipment and leases the service.  The satellite phones are used as a
back-up form of communications should the land lines ever go down. The FAA
does not have the ability to record the satellite telephones.

The WOC has three facsimile machines that are on a regular telephone line. The
lines that the facsimile machines are on are not tape-recorded.

Any of the administrative office lines associate with the WOC are off the FAA's
core phone system and are not tape-recorded.
label: Satellite/fax/administrative line recording scope

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text:
Any tape-recordings of the DEN are held for 30-days. The FAA uses a THALES
recorder to tape-record the DEN, and the other conversations on the conference
bridge. The maximum recording capacity of the system currently in place is 30-
days, hence, the reason the recordings are kept for 30-days. The tape-recordings
can be transferred to a DVD in a computer readable format.
label: DEN retention, capacity, THALES and DVD export

extraction: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True); page-local derivative lines, not agency line numbers
text:
There is currently no documented procedure for maintaining the tape-recordings of
the DEN.
label: June1addendum no documented maintenance procedure
